long_biography.plain_text:
University of Washington studies preceded Baty's first finance post at Nomura Securities. By 1996, he was vice president of Columbia Pacific Management, making property-related investment decisions within an enterprise associated with his father Daniel's decades in senior living. The position gave him an unusually powerful apprenticeship: access to operating companies, family capital and an international healthcare network. An Emeritus directorship added governance experience in assisted living before that company merged with Brookdale.

In 2006, Baty joined Daniel and Alex Washburn in establishing Columbia Pacific Advisors. As one of its leaders, he helped shape an alternative-asset business with strategies in property equity, commercial-property credit, middle-market business finance and special situations. He also retained responsibility for U.S. and Asian investments at the management company. Outside those roles, Baty has served organizations ranging from Seattle Bank and local schools to an affordable-housing foundation.
